alt: L’avi Ferran conversa amb el dependent d’una ferreteria.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one single landscape 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536×1024, for a Catalan listening-comprehension worksheet and catalogue card, printed around 80 mm wide. Reference images specify only canonical character appearance and established drawing style. Fine naturalistic ink and softly textured muted watercolor, warm paper fading into a generous pure-white border on all four edges; no frame. Warm gentle light, restrained earthy colors. Single coherent specific scene, large readable figures and natural hands, no panels, no labels, writing, numerals, logos or watermark. Keep all reference character faces, ages and clothing consistent; do not include the lettering or layout of the model sheets. Canonical Ferran: elderly man with wavy silver hair, short white beard, dark round glasses, charcoal cable-knit cardigan over sage checked shirt. Inside a neighborhood hardware shop, he stands at a wooden counter and speaks to an occasional male shopkeeper, middle-aged, clean-shaven, short receding dark hair and a blue checked shirt. Ferran has one hand just inside his cardigan pocket, the object completely hidden, and gestures mildly with his free hand. The shopkeeper leans in to listen. Soft shelves of anonymous hardware-storage bins and indistinct tool shapes establish the shop. Keep counter bare. Do not show a drawer knob, screw, any chosen hardware, quantities, a bag, a result or receipt. Do not copy any other recurring character for the shopkeeper.
encoding: WebP quality 90; original composition and dimensions retained.
